qualification.original_negative: First qualification #40087403495 failed because the restart test did not advance the new internal clock and a snapshot clock tamper was incorrectly accepted. The state serialization was strengthened to bind learned associations, pending actions, delivered-ticket ledger and clock to a deterministic integrity digest. The test was corrected; second qualification passed across both OS. Scientific results and source-role protocol were not revised based on prospective evidence.

development_study.matched_custody: All five querying policies have the same opaque relation-code universe, unlabeled DEV_FIT code frequencies, public consequence-channel glossary, three action requests, and two decision ticks of delayed feedback. No hidden mapping or check-case ground truth is available during querying.
development_study.restart: At the first delivered consequence, learner counts plus outstanding tickets and delivered-ticket ledger are canonically serialized, integrity-bound and restored without source meaning or oracle case objects. All remaining feedback subsequently matures and is counted exactly once.
development_study.resources: Code measures wall/CPU, serialized state bytes, peak Python traced memory for development, but energy/FLOPs and complete matched end-to-end training-inference Pareto are unmeasured.

interpretation.bounded_positive: An interacting agent can choose probes, receive delayed consequences without early exposure, update persistent association state and reuse it after an interrupted process across novel development entity bindings.
interpretation.competitive_negative: Uncertainty, greedy coverage, Bayesian information-gain approximation, fixed round-robin and deterministic random all achieve 12/12 under clean feedback with exactly the same probe budget. No comparative advantage or evidence of causal abstraction.
interpretation.critical_design_limit: The query budget (3) equals the number of possible codes (3). A balanced policy can exhaustively query all codes, so this setup cannot establish superior active information acquisition. The same development source families are used on both sides of the split.
interpretation.robustness_negative: Permuting feedback causes confidently incorrect predictions (0/12 exact, zero abstention for the five query policies); censoring feedback produces 12/12 abstentions, appropriately detecting insufficient information.
remaining_gaps: Source mappings are stationary and small, effect-channel meanings are provided explicitly and derived from source truth in the environment only.
Simulated restart is an internal serialization test, not a fully independent process or machine restart.
No unrehearsed prospective family was generated or scored; no unfamiliar causal-world transfer established.
No delayed multi-step state-dependent dynamics, compositional causal abstraction or interference/recovery advantage tested.
Cost/energy/FLOPs and independent standalone learned model process isolation unavailable.

next_scientific_gate: L10-B6 bounded information acquisition under genuine scarcity: before any new holdout, preregister budget strictly less than possible hidden mappings, asymmetric query value, delayed/noisy state-dependent outcomes, and independent causal intervention families. Compare a qualified learner to optimal Bayesian experimental design, active learning and fitted state-space/conventional controls under identical action/observation and resource budgets. Treat ties as scientific negatives; no L10-C first use without complete qualification.
